title: Retry order submission
summary: Wraps the order submit call in a three-attempt retry with backoff, so a brief upstream outage no longer fails checkout.

sections.title: Retry the submit call
sections.why: A failed POST is retried up to three times with exponential backoff. Check what happens when the first POST succeeded upstream but its response was lost.

sections.title: Sleep helper
sections.why: The backoff needs a promise-based delay.

items.title: A retry can create the order twice
items.body: The POST carries no idempotency key. If the upstream commits the order and the response times out, the retry posts it again and the customer is charged twice.

evidence.caption: Orders list after one checkout with the first response dropped: two orders
evidence.repro: make local-up && DROP_FIRST_RESPONSE=1 npm run e2e -- checkout

evidence.caption: Sequence of the double submit
evidence.text:
client -> api: POST /orders
api -> db: insert order 1
api -x client: response lost
client -> api: POST /orders (retry)
api -> db: insert order 2

items.title: Every error is retried, including 4xx
items.body: The ticket says to retry on outage. The change retries on any thrown error, so a validation failure is sent three times before the user sees it. Nothing in the ticket decides this.

items.title: The delay is injectable, so tests don't wait
items.body: sleep is its own module, so the retry test swaps it for a no-op and runs in milliseconds.
